mvp_assessment.reasoning: The project has successfully implemented all core Phase 1 requirements as defined in AGENTS.md, including a practitioner dashboard, secure patient roster, calendar/booking system, and structured clinical note-taking with discoveries and daily actions. Subsequent sprints have even added authentication, analytics, and telehealth integration, significantly exceeding the baseline MVP.

completed_features.title: Project Foundation & Practitioner Navigation Shell
completed_features.scope: Initialized Next.js 14 App Router project with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Lucide icons, and Supabase SSR setup. Created domain types, database migration SQL with RLS policies, patient and dashboard services, layout components (Sidebar, Header), practitioner dashboard page, and patient roster page with search and status filtering.
completed_features.layman_summary: We set up the core building blocks of Lumina Health! You can now launch the app, see a clean side navigation menu and top header, view a main Practitioner Dashboard displaying your daily statistics and scheduled appointments, and navigate to an active Patient Roster page with search and status filtering.

completed_features.title: Interactive Session Scheduler & Calendar View
completed_features.scope: Created /calendar page route, CalendarView component, NewAppointmentModal booking form, and appointmentService.ts backend module with getAppointments(), createAppointment(), and updateAppointmentStatus() handlers.
completed_features.layman_summary: You now have a dedicated Calendar page! You can visually view your upcoming therapy appointments, filter sessions by status (Scheduled, Completed, Cancelled), book new client sessions using a pop-up scheduling window, and mark completed sessions with a single click.

completed_features.title: Comprehensive Patient Detail Profile & Clinical History View
completed_features.scope: Created dynamic /patients/[id] route, PatientProfileHeader, PatientAppointmentHistory, PatientNotesHistory, PatientDetailTabs components, noteService.ts, and integrated getPatientById(), getAppointmentsByPatientId(), and getNotesByPatientId() service handlers.
completed_features.layman_summary: You can now click on any patient from the Patient Roster to open their dedicated Clinical Profile page! You will see their full demographic details, primary ailment focus, contact information, a complete timeline of structured past session notes (with clinical discoveries and assigned daily actions), and their full appointment history.

completed_features.title: Add New Patient Registration & Patient Roster Management
completed_features.scope: Created AddPatientModal.tsx, PatientRosterView.tsx, CreatePatientInput interface in lib/types/index.ts, and implemented createPatient() and updatePatient() handlers in patientService.ts. Enforced mandatory validations, DSM-5 primary focus dropdown, @-mention secondary tag system, click-outside modal dismissal, and React Portal rendering.
completed_features.layman_summary: You can now register new patients with mandatory DSM-5 primary diagnosis dropdowns, @-mention secondary comorbidity tags, and a responsive intake window with click-outside closure.

completed_features.title: Structured Clinical Note Creation Modal & Quick Entry Tool
completed_features.scope: Created components/notes/NewClinicalNoteModal.tsx, updated Header.tsx and PatientNotesHistory.tsx, and integrated createNote() and getAllNotes() in lib/services/noteService.ts. Enables structured clinical note logging with patient selection, session date picker, discoveries tag pills (@CBT-Insight), assigned client homework items list adder, and raw session summary notes.
completed_features.layman_summary: You can now add structured session notes from anywhere in the app! Clicking '+ Note' in the top header or '+ Add Note' in a patient's chart opens a quick pop-up window where you can select a patient, tag key clinical findings (like CBT insights or anxiety triggers), assign client homework/daily action tasks, and save session summaries directly to their clinical record.

completed_features.title: Global Header Real-Time Search & Quick Actions Hub
completed_features.scope: Created components/layout/GlobalSearchBar.tsx, updated Header.tsx, created lib/services/searchService.ts, and added SearchResultItem DTO in lib/types/index.ts. Enables live real-time multi-resource practice search across Patients, Clinical Notes, and Appointments with debounced queries, categorized icons/badges, click-outside dismissal, Esc shortcut, and instant navigation.
completed_features.layman_summary: You now have a powerful live search bar right in the top navigation header! As you type a patient name, clinical tag (like @CBT-Insight), or session date, a floating menu instantly displays categorized search results across your patients, session notes, and calendar appointments, letting you jump directly to any record with one click.

completed_features.title: Clinical Note Editing & Management Module
completed_features.scope: Created components/notes/EditClinicalNoteModal.tsx, updated PatientNotesHistory.tsx with Edit (Pencil) and Delete (Trash2) note controls, and integrated updateNote() and deleteNote() service handlers in lib/services/noteService.ts. Includes delete confirmation dialog, pre-filled form fields, discoveries tag adder, client homework list modifier, and real-time timeline state updates.
completed_features.layman_summary: You can now edit or delete any clinical note directly from a patient's progress timeline! Clicking the pencil icon opens an Edit Note window pre-filled with the existing session date, clinical discoveries, homework tasks, and summary text. Clicking the trash icon displays a safety confirmation prompt before permanently deleting the note.

completed_features.title: Patient Record Archive & Status Lifecycle Management
completed_features.scope: Updated PatientStatus type in lib/types/index.ts, implemented updatePatientStatus() handler in patientService.ts, added status lifecycle selector dropdown in PatientProfileHeader.tsx, and integrated status filter tab bar (All Patients, Active, Inactive, Completed Therapy, Archived) with live count pills in PatientRosterView.tsx.
completed_features.layman_summary: You can now manage patient therapy lifecycles! Clicking the status badge on a patient's chart opens a quick dropdown where you can update their status (Active Care, Inactive / On Pause, Completed Therapy, Archived). On the Patient Roster page, you can click filter tabs to view active caseloads or review historical completed and archived charts with real-time count badges.

completed_features.title: Practitioner Authentication & Registration Flow
completed_features.scope: Implemented authService.ts with login, register, logout, getCurrentUser, and getSession handlers supporting dual-mode execution (Supabase Auth + local mock session fallback). Created /login and /register page routes with modern form controls, input validations, error state alerts, and updated Header navigation with active practitioner profile display and logout dropdown. Created unit test file __tests__/sprints/sprint9_auth.test.ts and E2E browser test file e2e/sprints/sprint9_auth.spec.ts.
completed_features.layman_summary: Practitioners can now log in and register for Lumina Health! You can access dedicated /login and /register pages with clean input forms, validation, and error alerts. Once logged in, your practitioner profile (Dr. Sarah Jenkins) displays in the top navigation header with an interactive dropdown to log out at any time.

completed_features.title: Clinical Decision-Making Analytics Hub (Patient Health, Business Dynamics & Capacity Engine)
completed_features.scope: Refactored analytics module into a 3-category clinical decision engine. Implemented getDecisionAnalyticsHubData handler in analyticsService.ts. Created /analytics page route, DecisionAnalyticsHub container shell, ClinicalOutcomesTab (symptom severity trends & DSM-5 distribution), PracticeDynamicsTab (treatment retention funnel stages & monthly attendance vs cancellations), and CaseloadCapacityTab (mental bandwidth capacity dial gauge SVG, weekly workload density heatmap, and burnout risk status). Updated unit test suite __tests__/sprints/sprint10_analytics.test.ts and E2E browser test suite e2e/sprints/sprint10_analytics.spec.ts.
completed_features.layman_summary: Your Analytics page is now a powerful Clinical Decision Engine! You can toggle between 3 targeted views: 1) Clinical Outcomes (track if patients are actually improving over time with symptom severity trend graphs), 2) Practice Dynamics (see client retention funnel drop-offs and cancellation rates), and 3) Caseload & Capacity (monitor your mental bandwidth dial gauge and weekly workload density to prevent practitioner burnout).

completed_features.title: Analytics Dashboard Visual Refactor & Expansion
completed_features.scope: Refactored the AnalyticsDashboard.tsx UI to use CircularKPICard and other visual progress indicators across the clinical, practice, and caseload tabs. Truncated list items (e.g. Burnout Risk Assessment) to 5 items with an expand/collapse toggle. Replaced text-based KPI metrics and icons with percentage progress bars to match the premium design style.
completed_features.layman_summary: We've significantly upgraded the visual experience of the Analytics page! The simple text numbers across all your key performance indicators have been transformed into beautiful circular progress rings and charts. We also made long lists (like the Burnout Risk factors) collapse after 5 items with an 'expand' button, keeping the interface clean and instantly understandable.

completed_features.title: Analytics Dashboard Clinical Lists Truncation
completed_features.scope: Implemented a 5-item truncation with an expand/collapse toggle button for the Symptom Severity Line Trend and DSM-5 Diagnostic Distribution lists in the clinical outcomes tab. Ensured expand buttons only render when the list length strictly exceeds 5 items.
completed_features.layman_summary: We've extended the clean, collapsible list behavior to the Clinical Outcomes section. If you track many different patient symptoms or DSM-5 diagnoses over time, those lists will now neatly collapse to show only the top 5, with a button to instantly view the rest of your clinical data.

completed_features.title: Clinical Discoveries Responsive Layout Truncation
completed_features.scope: Implemented a dynamic React useEffect algorithm in ClinicalDiscoveriesChart.tsx to compute the number of CSS grid columns based on viewport width (mobile: 1, tablet: 2, desktop: 3). Truncated the list dynamically to strictly render only 2 rows when collapsed (e.g. max 6 items on desktop, 4 on tablet, 2 on mobile), complete with a dynamic expand/collapse toggle.
completed_features.layman_summary: The Top Clinical Discoveries grid now intelligently adapts to your screen size! Whether you are on a phone, a tablet, or a massive desktop monitor, the grid will calculate how much space it has and cleanly truncate the list to show exactly 2 rows of discovery cards, keeping your dashboard beautifully aligned.

completed_features.title: Clinical Outcomes Dashboard Re-Architecture
completed_features.scope: Redesigned the Clinical Outcomes charts grid. Swapped the layout order so DSM-5 Diagnostic Distribution renders on the left, and Symptom Severity Line Trend renders on the right. Refactored the grid columns from a 1:1 ratio to a 3:2 ratio (lg:grid-cols-5). Replaced text-based severity labels with color-coded dot badges for instant visual scanning.
completed_features.layman_summary: We've fine-tuned the Clinical Outcomes layout for maximum readability. The denser diagnostic distribution breakdown now anchors the left side of your screen with more breathing room (3/5ths width), while the line trend sits cleanly on the right (2/5ths width). We also stripped out redundant text and replaced it with beautiful, color-coded severity dots so you can process the data at a single glance!

completed_features.title: Universal Dashboard Layout Synchronization
completed_features.scope: Propagated the 3:2 responsive grid layout ratio and minimal color-coded dot badge design language across the Practice Dynamics and Caseload & Capacity tabs in AnalyticsDashboard.tsx. Reordered components for optimal visual weight distribution and removed native HTML bullet points in favor of custom flex-aligned dot indicators.
completed_features.layman_summary: We've fully synchronized the entire Analytics Dashboard! The beautiful, spacious layout and clean, color-coded dot indicators you loved in the Clinical Outcomes tab have now been applied perfectly to the Practice Dynamics and Capacity tabs as well, providing a perfectly unified, premium experience across your entire workflow.

completed_features.title: Practice Dynamics Funnel Layout Swap
completed_features.scope: Refactored the Practice Dynamics charts row. Swapped the DOM ordering so the Treatment Retention Funnel Chart renders on the left with a 3-column span (lg:col-span-3), while the Monthly Attendance & Cancellations table renders on the right with a 2-column span (lg:col-span-2).
completed_features.layman_summary: We've swapped the layout on the Practice Dynamics tab! The Treatment Retention Funnel now sits beautifully on the left side of your screen with extra breathing room to display those conversion stages, pushing the denser attendance numbers neatly to the right.

completed_features.title: Practice Dynamics Attendance Stacked Bar Chart
completed_features.scope: Replaced the raw HTML data table for Monthly Attendance & Cancellations with a beautiful, fully responsive custom CSS stacked bar chart. Padded with mock data for a full year view. Implemented dynamic stack height styling across Attended (dark indigo), Cancelled (medium indigo), and No-Show (light indigo) segments. Added a 'Month' selector dropdown and a clean color legend.
completed_features.layman_summary: We've completely overhauled how you view your monthly attendance! We stripped out the boring data table and replaced it with a sleek, highly-visual stacked bar chart, mimicking your premium design reference. You can now effortlessly see your scheduled vs attended vs cancelled sessions stacked beautifully across the entire year, complete with a month selector and color-coded legend!

completed_features.title: Practice Dynamics Deep UI Refinements
completed_features.scope: Refined the Top Cancellation Reason KPI card into a stacked horizontal bar chart representing top 3 reasons (Late Cancellation, Financial, No Show). Refactored the Monthly Attendance chart header to be full width, adding a state-bound month selector dropdown. Displayed the dynamically calculated Average Attendance inline with the header. Downscaled the chart bars to a tighter 70% height ratio.
completed_features.layman_summary: The Practice Dynamics tab has received its final coat of polish! Your Top Cancellation reason is now a beautiful mini-chart showing the top 3 breakdown. We also fine-tuned the Attendance chart—giving it sleeker, lower-profile bars (70% height) and a fully functional month selector that automatically updates your average attendance right in the header!

completed_features.title: Practice Dynamics KPI Alignment
completed_features.scope: Aligned the Month Selector dropdown to the right edge of the header container using flex justify-between. Consolidated the Cancellation metrics by removing the redundant Cancellation Rate card. Restored the Top Cancellation Reason back into a CircularKPICard, passing the top reason as the bold title and the cancellation rate as the subtext. Rebalanced the grid to a symmetrical 3-column layout.
completed_features.layman_summary: We've perfectly aligned the elements in the Practice Dynamics tab. The Month selector now snaps cleanly to the right side of the chart. We also cleaned up the top row by removing redundant cards and turning the Top Cancellation Reason back into a beautiful circular ring, perfectly matching the design language of the rest of the dashboard.

completed_features.title: Practice Dynamics Chart Scaling & Percentage Refinement
completed_features.scope: Dynamically calculated the overall attendance percentage based on the selected month's mock data and rendered it in the chart header, replacing the raw session count. Increased the CSS height constraint on the Monthly Attendance stacked bar chart container by roughly 30% (h-[256px]) to improve vertical data legibility.
completed_features.layman_summary: The Practice Dynamics tab has received its final polishing touches! The Monthly Attendance chart now displays your actual dynamic attendance percentage in the header instead of raw session numbers. We also increased the vertical height of the stacked bars by 30%, giving the entire chart significantly more breathing room!

completed_features.title: Telehealth / Video Meeting Link Integration & Launch Pad
completed_features.scope: Added `telehealth_url` and `telehealth_provider` fields to the backend `Appointment` interface. Updated `appointmentService.ts` to support saving telehealth metadata. Built UI integration into `NewAppointmentModal` for capturing Zoom/Meet links, and deployed dynamic 'Join Call' buttons directly into the dashboard timeline, calendar blocks, and patient appointment history tables.
completed_features.layman_summary: We've fully integrated telehealth directly into your practice workflow! You can now attach Zoom, Google Meet, or Microsoft Teams links right when you schedule an appointment. Even better, sleek 'Join Call' buttons now appear across your main dashboard, calendar, and patient histories—allowing you to jump into back-to-back virtual sessions with a single click.

completed_features.title: Global Booking FAB & Seamless Session Details
completed_features.scope: Injected a persistent Floating Action Button into AppLayout to trigger routing to the calendar scheduling view. Removed redundant headers from CalendarView. Removed explicit 'Details' buttons from appointment cards, making the entire card clickable. Upgraded the details modal to dynamically search and inject previous session notes for the patient directly into the modal.
completed_features.layman_summary: We've made prepping for sessions incredibly fast. You can now click anywhere on a booked calendar card to open it, and we've upgraded the modal to automatically surface the notes from the patient's previous session alongside your video links! Plus, there is now a global 'Book' button anchored to the bottom right of every screen so you can schedule instantly from anywhere.

completed_features.title: Calendar Modal Query Parameter Routing
completed_features.scope: Implemented `useSearchParams` listener in `CalendarView.tsx` to automatically trigger the `NewAppointmentModal` state to open when the `?new=true` parameter is present in the URL path. This fully connects the global FAB button logic.
completed_features.layman_summary: We've wired up the global 'Book' button! No matter what page you are on, clicking that button will seamlessly drop you into the calendar view and instantly pop open the new appointment modal.

completed_features.title: Calendar Modal Click-Outside Dismissal
completed_features.scope: Added `onClick` dismissal logic to the appointment details modal backdrop overlay in `CalendarView.tsx`, while enforcing `stopPropagation` on the modal container to prevent accidental closures while interacting with the modal contents.
completed_features.layman_summary: We've added a highly-requested UX upgrade to the calendar! You can now instantly close the session details modal simply by clicking anywhere in the dark background outside of the card.

completed_features.title: Global Appointment Status Filtering & Styling
completed_features.scope: Filtered out cancelled appointments entirely from the rendering arrays in `CalendarView.tsx`, `UpcomingAppointments.tsx`, and `PatientAppointmentHistory.tsx`. Applied the visual `opacity-75 line-through` styling to completed appointments across all views to simulate a crossed-off task.
completed_features.layman_summary: We've cleaned up your views! Cancelled sessions now instantly vanish from your calendar and dashboard to reduce visual clutter, while completed sessions now get a satisfying strikethrough effect so you can visually check them off as you power through your day.

completed_features.title: Completed Session Undo Toggle
completed_features.scope: Updated the 'Mark Completed' button logic in `CalendarView.tsx`. The button no longer unmounts when the session is completed; instead, it transitions to a green active state and dynamically binds its `onClick` handler to revert the session back to 'scheduled', functioning as an undo toggle.
completed_features.layman_summary: We've added a highly-requested safety net to your calendar. If you accidentally mark a session as completed, the green checkmark button remains on the card—simply click it again to instantly undo the action and return the session to your scheduled list!

completed_features.title: Live Backend Database Migration (Supabase)
completed_features.scope: Transition the application from mock data to a live Supabase PostgreSQL database. Generate SQL schema with RLS policies and swap the service layer to use the `@supabase/ssr` client for persistent storage.
completed_features.layman_summary: We did it! Lumina Health is now running on a live, cloud-hosted PostgreSQL database. All your patient data, appointments, and clinical notes are now securely persisted with enterprise-grade Row Level Security. The app is officially a real, functional software product!

proposed_features.title: Clinical Summary Report & Chart Export Hub
proposed_features.scope: Adds printable clinical progress summaries and downloadable patient record exports for clinical reviews and care coordination.

proposed_features.title: Interactive Clinical Treatment Plan Builder
proposed_features.scope: Allows practitioners to define long-term therapeutic goals, track milestone progress, and link daily assigned actions to overarching treatment plans for each patient.

pending_options.title: Multi-Practitioner Practice Role Access & Audit Logs
pending_options.scope: Introduces staff roles (Admin vs. Practitioner) and immutable event logs for compliance-ready patient data access tracking.

pending_options.title: AI-Assisted Clinical Pattern Recognition
pending_options.scope: Background analytical engine examining structured discoveries and daily actions to highlight correlations for practitioners.

pending_options.title: Automated Session Reminders & Patient Notification Hub
pending_options.scope: Introduces automated email/SMS reminders for upcoming appointments and a central notification center for tracking sent alerts.

pending_options.title: Secure Practitioner Messaging & Care Team Chat
pending_options.scope: Provides a secure, internal chat module for practitioners and staff to communicate safely regarding practice updates and care coordination.

issue_log.problem: TypeScript type mismatches for PractitionerDashboardStats and optional Patient/Appointment fields.
issue_log.resolution: Exported PractitionerDashboardStats and aligned Patient/Appointment DTOs in lib/types/index.ts.

issue_log.problem: Function signature mismatches in getAppointments() and createAppointment() requiring explicit practitionerId.
issue_log.resolution: Added default parameters (practitionerId = 'prac-1') and fixed client import in appointmentService.ts.

issue_log.problem: Missing PatientDetailTabs component and duplicate function declarations in appointmentService.ts and mockData.ts.
issue_log.resolution: Created PatientDetailTabs.tsx and removed duplicate function/data declarations in appointmentService.ts and mockData.ts.

issue_log.problem: Viewport padding offset and layout cropping on low-resolution screens for intake modal.
issue_log.resolution: Applied createPortal to document.body and bounded scrollable form container with fixed action footer.

issue_log.problem: Missing getAllNotes() handler in noteService.ts for querying practice-wide notes timeline.
issue_log.resolution: Implemented getAllNotes() in noteService.ts with in-memory fallback and Supabase integration.

issue_log.problem: Patient row and dashboard schedule items requiring specific arrow button click to open profile.
issue_log.resolution: Made entire patient table rows (PatientTable) and dashboard appointment/note item cards (UpcomingAppointments, RecentNotes) clickable with cursor-pointer and hover highlights.

issue_log.problem: Searching tag queries with @ prefix (e.g. @mild) failing to match ailment or tag text fields.
issue_log.resolution: Normalized search query in searchService.ts by stripping leading @ or # symbols, searching case-insensitively across patient names, primary ailments, secondary ailments, and tags array.

issue_log.problem: Newly edited clinical notes reverting to original state after router.refresh() and session date shifting in edit modal.
issue_log.resolution: Updated PatientNotesHistory useEffect to compare updated_at timestamps when merging server props with local state, and added formatForDateInput helper in EditClinicalNoteModal to preserve exact session dates.

issue_log.problem: Editing a note after deleting another note returning 'Note not found in memory' error.
issue_log.resolution: Updated updateNote handler in noteService.ts to gracefully upsert missing notes into the in-memory array if noteIndex === -1.

issue_log.problem: Deleted clinical notes being restored from static server props upon router.refresh() and overwriting newer notes.
issue_log.resolution: Added deletedIds state set in PatientNotesHistory to filter out erased note IDs from incoming server props and local state merging.

issue_log.problem: WeeklySessionTrendChart bars rendering with 0 height causing the chart to appear completely empty despite having valid scheduled sessions data.
issue_log.resolution: Added h-full to the flex column wrapper inside the chart component to prevent items-end flexbox property from collapsing the bar container's relative height.
